parameters.name: HaVipId
parameters.description: The ID of the HAVIP that you want to modify.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the HAVIP. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-ha-vip-attribute --ha-vip-id havip-52y280000 --name test --region cn-hangzhou
